connector.name: MCP Btg
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for BTG Pactual - Pix, Boleto, Account, Investments (CDB/LCI/LCA/funds), OAuth2 + mTLS
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-btg. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the codespar account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: BTG_CLIENT_ID
env.description: BTG OAuth client_id issued via the Developer Portal after contract onboarding.

env.name: BTG_CERT_PATH
env.description: Absolute path to the mTLS client certificate (.crt or .pem). BACEN mandates mTLS for Pix v2; BTG enforces it across product families.

env.name: BTG_KEY_PATH
env.description: Absolute path to the mTLS private key (.key or .pem).
